title: High-throughput homogenization of Drosophila melanogaster larvae using a bead mill-style homogenizer
protocol: Wash Drosophila larvae 3 times with 1 ml PBS to remove food, surface bacteria, and other contaminants.
Aspirate the larvae or remove as much liquid as possible with a pipette.
Place 10-300 mg of larvae into microcentrifuge tubes.
Add an equal mass of 0.5 mm glass beads to the tube.
Add 2 volumes of buffer for every mass of larvae.
Close the microcentrifuge tubes and place them into the Bullet Blender TM.
Run the tubes for 3 minutes at speed 8.
